why: G4.5c rewrites driver scripts in a project directory that is not under version control.  This is the restore point: a full manifest and a verified archive taken before the first rewrite.  Nothing in work/ has been modified.
manifest_method: os.walk(followlinks=False), lstat per entry, sha256 of every regular file, mtime_ns and size recorded, symlinks recorded with their target.  No entry is excluded.
restore_method: the scratch tree was rebuilt from the archive alone (zstd -dc | tar -x), re-hashed file by file, and compared against the manifest: no missing, no extra, no mismatched.  The scratch copy was then deleted; the archive is the backup.

tooling.zstd: *** Zstandard CLI (64-bit) v1.5.7, by Yann Collet ***

compile_check_before_rewrite: every driver under work/ is compile-checked with the branch interpreter before and after each rewrite batch, so a syntax break is caught even for scripts that are never executed again.
